products.title: GoldPlus GP-C12 GaN USB-C Fast Charger with USB-C to Lightning iPhone Cable (UK plug)
products.shortDescription: Full set for iPhone: compact GaN charger plus a braided Type-C to Lightning cable. Real output about 20W, the speed an iPhone fast-charges at. UK plug.
products.longDescription: This is the full set for an iPhone: a small GaN charger for the wall and a braided Type-C to Lightning cable, so you are not buying the cable separately. One honest note on the power. The box is printed 50W, but the charger's own ratings (5V 3A, 9V 2.2A, 12V 1.6A) add up to about 20W, and that is what we list. 20W is exactly what an iPhone takes for fast charging, so the phone charges fast; it is not a laptop charger. GaN parts stay cooler than an old-style charger, and it has temperature, overcurrent and short-circuit protection. UK 3-pin plug, so it fits every socket in Uganda. Every unit is tested before it is sold; same-day delivery in Kampala and Wakiso.
